display_name: spring-boot + nginx (3 replicas, no CPU limits)
description: Experimental, not for merge. spring-boot-gateway-3 without CPU limits: 3 Spring Boot replicas behind one nginx edge share 24 logical CPUs with no CFS quota, like pods with requests but no limits. Each runs with -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=8, 16g of memory and a 64-connection Hikari pool; compare with spring-boot-gateway-3 (limited) and spring-boot-gateway-8-unlimited.
